Overview

Pattaya is a city in Chon Buri with a population of 500,000. A coastal city on the Gulf of Thailand known for its beaches, nightlife, and large expat retirement community with affordable living costs. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 7b growing zone supports Mild — wide variety of vegetables, many fruit trees.
